metadata.title: NextPilotAI
metadata.description: Modern websites, web applications and AI-powered business automation in Lugano, Switzerland.

hero.description: NextPilot AI designs websites, web applications, automation and artificial intelligence as a single system: your business stops depending on scattered tools and starts working in a coordinated way.
hero.trust: You talk directly to the person who builds it, with no one in between.

signals.title: Transparent process
signals.text: Clear steps from idea to launch

problems.heading: The same difficulties keep repeating across many businesses.
problems.lead: A website that doesn't generate leads, requests getting lost between WhatsApp and email, tools that don't talk to each other: these are rarely isolated problems — more often they're the same problem seen from different angles.

items.label: The website isn't working for you
items.text: It's online, but it doesn't drive any concrete action and doesn't reflect the real level of the business.

items.label: Requests get lost
items.text: Between WhatsApp, email and phone calls, an interested contact can simply disappear.

items.label: Too much work done by hand
items.text: Data copied from one system to another, separate calendars and spreadsheets that nobody actually keeps in sync.

items.label: It's not clear what's really needed
items.text: A website, an app, an automation: without an overall view, you risk paying for the wrong thing.

problems.transition: It's never a single tool that makes the difference, but the way the whole system works together.

solutions.heading: Every business needs its own solution.
solutions.lead: Website, application, automation or integration — the right choice depends on what is actually holding the business back.

items.title: Present the business online
items.description: A modern website makes the value of the business clear and guides visitors toward the right action.
items.result: More trust, clarity and qualified enquiries.

items.title: Manage internal processes
items.description: When spreadsheets, messages and separate tools stop being enough, the team needs a system built around how it actually works.
items.result: Fewer manual steps and clearer processes.

items.title: Reduce manual work
items.description: Automation handles repetitive tasks, data and documents where it can genuinely save time.
items.result: Less routine work, more time for what matters.

items.title: Sell and connect systems
items.description: Sales, payments, CRM and other tools can work as one connected system without duplicate data entry.
items.result: Connected sales and data without unnecessary manual work.

solutions.transition: The best solution often combines several areas — so the system is designed first.

process.heading: From problem to working system.
process.lead: First we understand the challenge, then design the solution, build it in stages and verify the result before launch.

steps.title: Analysis
steps.description: Understand the challenge, goals and constraints.

steps.title: Architecture
steps.description: Design the system before writing code.

steps.title: Launch
steps.description: Verify, refine and deliver the solution.

cases.heading: How a chaotic process becomes a system.
cases.lead: These demonstrative scenarios show how fragmented processes can become a clear, manageable system — step by step.

items.title: Automatic request management
items.problema: Clients write in from different channels — website, WhatsApp, email, phone — and requests get lost, duplicated, or left unanswered.
items.risultato: Every request arrives in one place, gets a clear status, and the team always knows who has already replied and what to do next.
items.tecnologie: Next.js · NestJS · PostgreSQL · AI · Email and messaging integration

items.title: Automatic document processing
items.problema: A PDF document arrives, and someone has to read it, copy the data by hand and enter it into another system.
items.risultato: Documents get processed faster, data becomes structured, and a person verifies the result instead of retyping everything by hand.
items.tecnologie: Next.js · AI/LLM · PDF extraction · PostgreSQL · Data verification

items.title: Booking and appointment management
items.problema: Clients call or write to ask about availability, and someone has to check the calendar by hand, reply, and remember the appointment.
items.risultato: The client books without long back-and-forth messaging, the calendar updates itself, and forgotten appointments decrease.
items.tecnologie: Next.js · Calendar API · Email and Telegram · Automation · Database

cta.heading: Do you have a similar process in your business?
cta.text: You don't need to know which technology to use: it starts with the problem, and the right solution gets built together from there.
